race.description: Happy 65th Birthday Stephen Fairless Mdn Plate (C1)
race.comment: SHAKESPEARE'S GIRL (11) brings the right form to the table third up with the winkers going on. Strong through the line with a tough second over 1400m at this track after being in contention on the corner. No excuses today. FAMAHAN (2) slow into stride from the outside draw and never in contention when sixth over 1400m at Scone. Best figures measure up nicely and trained on the track. KRYSTINA KERIMA (6) six weeks between runs when he knocked up late to finish fourth over 1400m at Scone. Open to further improvement and should run the 1600m. Each way. OMINOUS (10) is now in the David Hatch yard. Failed to handle the Pakenham Synthetic track at his last two outings. Keep safe in a fairly average race.
